ChampionsPath_Text_Npc0.fr: Chaque champion a emprunté ce\nchemin une fois.
ChampionsPath_Text_Npc0.en: Every champion has walked this path\nonce.

ChampionsPath_Text_Npc1.fr: J'étais fort, autrefois. Maintenant\nje suis sage.
ChampionsPath_Text_Npc1.en: I was strong, once. Now I am wise.

ChampionsPath_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

ChampionsPath_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
ChampionsPath_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
